visual_thesis: Reviewer feedback becomes reusable evaluation criteria, not automatic model training. At phone scale follow traces through annotations to tests; full size distinguishes unchanged expected outputs, generated rubrics and privacy constraints.
mechanism_metaphor: A continuous fan-shaped evidence weave viewed from directly above. Three nested trace ribbons open from lower-left, with distinct conversation-turn blocks and one marked failure location, all faces blank. A coral annotation seam stitches a rating marker, category tag, comment bubble without writing and expected-output blank specimen into a curated central weave. To the upper-right the weave separates two complementary strips: exact expected-output preservation and inspected task rubric. A new response specimen is held opposite both strips by a nondirectional comparison brace. Two and only two slender directed connectors: trace port to annotation port and annotation port to curated test join. The rubric strip is connected to the curated join by a headless association line. Privacy, retention and access appear as three separate outline sleeves around the trace inlet with no shields or locks. Distinct useful elements: full trace, turn context, error location, rating marker, tag, blank comment, expected-output specimen, curation seam, exact-output strip, rubric strip, new-response specimen, comparison brace, privacy sleeve, retention sleeve and access sleeve. Detached caveat below. No circular training loop, gears or rating numbers.
